algorithm_long: Supervised gradient fine-tuning of the public TabPFN-v2 regression foundation model for crystal-structure exfoliation energy. Analytic composition and periodic geometry yield 370 features. For each official outer TRAIN fold independently, composition-group three-fold CV selects one of four fixed fine-tuning configurations, followed by actual gradient refitting on the entire outer TRAIN. Four final folds update the full network and one updates only its readout. All five final models are frozen before separate-process witness replay and any held-out prediction or native scoring. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
notes: Only matbench_jdft2d (636 real held-out predictions) is submitted, not all 13 tasks. Native mean five-fold MAE=28.733328891325755 meV/atom; fold standard deviation=9.38087794130482. Final refits have 15/30/30/30/30 actual gradient steps; each starts from the identical original public V2 checkpoint. No outer-test feedback is used for training, calibration, configuration selection or ensembling. Development was confined to fold0 TRAIN; final inner selection is performed separately in every official TRAIN fold. The fold0 inner results were reused only after exact input/split/config verification, while its final full-TRAIN model was genuinely refit. Training sets of different official folds naturally overlap; every model uses only its own TRAIN labels. No pretrained no-gradient fallback is selected. A single A100-SXM4-80GB was used per job. This trained method is distinct from the previously submitted no-gradient TabPFN-HYD steel method. Public preparation and executed worker equivalence are checked; the complete public orchestration is not claimed separately retrained end-to-end.
